title: Input-output analysis with a sphere packing approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.23391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Input-output analysis with linear programming is widely used in the planning of national economies. However, linear programming attains its optimum at a vertex of the feasible set, and a small deviation of the optimal plan in some direction violates a constraint. So far, little attention has been paid to finding sets of production plans which guarantee both the supply-demand balance of an economy and a given level of its gross domestic product (GDP), and the sphere packing approach cannot be applied directly, since the balance equations define a set with an empty interior. In this paper, we introduce the set of $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-solutions, in which GDP may be smaller than its optimal value by at most $\varepsilon$ and supply may differ from demand by at most $\delta$, and we find a sphere with the maximum radius inscribed into this set by solving a linear programming problem. We prove that the optimal radius is positive for positive

translated_title: 基于球堆积方法的投入产出分析
translated_abstract: 基于线性规划的投入产出分析被广泛应用于国民经济规划。然而，线性规划在可行集的顶点处取得最优解，最优计划在某些方向上的微小偏差就会违反约束。迄今为止，人们在寻找既能保证经济体供需平衡、又能保证其国内生产总值（GDP）达到给定水平的生产计划集合方面关注甚少，且球堆积方法无法直接应用，因为平衡方程所定义的集合内部是空的。本文中，我们引入了 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-解的集合，其中 GDP 最多比其最优值小 $\varepsilon$，供给与需求之差最多为 $\delta$，并通过求解一个线性规划问题，找到了内切于该集合的最大半径球体。我们证明了对于正的（原文在此截断），最优半径为正。
tldr: 本文提出 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-解集合的概念，将带约束的经济平衡问题转化为求解内切于该集合的最大半径球体的线性规划问题，从而为国民经济规划提供既保证供需平衡又保证 GDP 水平的鲁棒生产计划。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the set of $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-solutions and finds the maximum-radius sphere inscribed in it via a linear programming problem, providing robust production plans that guarantee both supply-demand balance and a given GDP level in national economic planning.
